blocked_analysis.analysis: The read objective and standard operation are identifiable. Payload selector, schema and expected state are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Restores safe read-only automation coverage while preventing log deletion, returned-port connection and automatic mutation in response to an unexpected state.
independent_technical_reasoning: A status query is useful only when its selector and response layout are pinned: otherwise an inactive result may describe the wrong instance. Because the response can reveal a live session or port, evidence must be redacted and an unexpected active state must stop the case rather than authorize cleanup automatically.
